# Pace

> On-device Mac voice agent that reads your screen and acts with local context.

## Product

- [Home](https://heypace.app/): Product landing
- [Download](https://heypace.app/download): Current release and requirements
- [Pricing](https://heypace.app/pricing): Free, one-time, and optional hosted tiers
- [FAQ](https://heypace.app/faq): Privacy, hardware, models, recordings, refunds, and safety
- [Compared](https://heypace.app/compared): Honest macOS voice-agent comparisons
- [Changelog](https://heypace.app/changelog): Verified shipped outcomes
- [Docs](https://heypace.app/docs/): Blume documentation and searchable project knowledge
